title: 第3章 大日星槎第4章 父母
content_zh:
序列9“旅行商人”
这就是对所谓九品箓位“星河转运副使”
的翻译？很接地气啊……
但你给我看所谓序列或者箓位又是几个意思？我这“金手指”
就没个说明吗？
然而，他刚想到这里，大段的信息流就突然浮现在了赵晨的脑海里，让他陷入了短暂的恍惚之中。
几秒后，他的眼神恢复了清明，对于身处的宫殿和眼前书案上的金印、玉册、朱笔也有了较为完善的了解。
“这个宫殿原来是‘大日星槎’的一部分。
“而所谓‘大日星槎’是一艘可以在虚空中航行，行商万界的宝船，就是它带我进入的这个世界……
“‘大日星槎’的具体来历并不在我刚才得到的知识里，不过它在突破此界之外那些邪神的封锁时受到了重创，丢失了许多部件，目前只得隐藏在我的灵魂深处，与我是共生关系。
“原来那真的不是梦……此界之外真的有诸多邪神盘踞！
“而所谓箓位，就是它开放给我的权限等级……一旦接受箓位，就可以提升我的实力，使用它的功能。
“不过我现在虽然莫名得到了‘旅行商人’的箓位，却并没有相应的提升……一来是我的‘贡献’不够，二来则是‘大日星槎’的核心部件有着缺失，需要找到才能举行完整的‘授箓’仪式。
“不过‘旅行商人’在星槎内的‘交易’功能却是已经可以使用了，只要用‘大日星槎’认可的名为‘星币’的一般等价物，就可以兑换到它收藏的部分知识、物品，甚至是法术、能力。
“而我以半个‘旅行商人’箓位能兑换的东西有……”
赵晨边整理着刚刚获得的信息，边用意识“点”
开了书案上的那本“玉册”
同样是金光闪现，半空中玉册投影出的影像缓缓展开，列出了当前能够兑换的物品列表：
“《睚眦咒诅密录》残篇，300星币。
“《计都星神法》真气卷，400星币。

“一道‘摧魂夺魄诅咒术’低配版法术，80星币。
“邪道‘方虚子’残魂，130星币。
“方虚子人生记忆片段，50星币一次。”
除此之外，还有原身赵晨的记忆和部分知识，只是处于质押状态，暂时不能兑换。
结合兑换列表里呈现出的内容，以及刚刚得到的“大日星槎”
介绍，赵晨略一思索，就对原主的死因有了猜测：
“原主应该是被那个叫作‘方虚子’的邪道诅咒而死的……他在死亡的瞬间，恰好遇到了‘大日星槎’带我穿越至此，于是他用自己包括命运、灵魂在内的一切，和‘大日星槎’做了交易，只要我能找出凶手，为他报仇，就能顶替他，成为他……
“这恐怕就是我会在他身上苏醒的原因。
“而我之所以见到‘熟人’就能得到相应的记忆，也是因为对查找真凶有利，提前预支给我的报酬。
“另外，那个方虚子应该是见诅咒没有奏效，在今晚又来了一次……可惜，原本的赵晨已经是‘大日星槎’的抵押物，他的‘诅咒’等同于动了星槎的收藏品，自然触发了这里的反击机制，这才被借着联系强行剥夺了一半的灵魂作为赔偿。
“呵，失去了一半灵魂的邪道这会儿怕是已经成傻子了吧？原主的仇等于报了一半？
“就是不知道这个邪道是和原主有仇怨才这么害他，还是有人买凶杀人了……嗯，兑换出那个所谓‘记忆片段’有一定概率得到答案，但也可能什么有价值的情报都没有，毕竟他至少活了几十年，无用的垃圾记忆占大部分……那其实就是个‘盲盒’！
content_en:
Sequence 9 "Traveling Merchant"
This is the so-called ninth-grade "Galaxy Transport Deputy Envoy"
Translation? Very down to earth...
But tell me what the so-called sequence or position means? My "golden finger"
Is there no explanation?
However, as soon as he thought of this, a large stream of information suddenly appeared in Zhao Chen's mind, causing him to fall into a brief trance.
After a few seconds, his eyes returned to clarity, and he had a relatively complete understanding of the palace he was in and the gold seals, jade albums, and ink pens on the desk in front of him.
"This palace was originally part of the Great Sun Star.
“And the so-called ‘Dairi Xingcha’ is a treasure ship that can sail in the void and conduct business in all worlds. This is the world it brought me into...
"The specific origin of the 'Big Sun Star Cha' is not in the knowledge I just gained, but it was severely damaged when it broke through the blockade of the evil gods outside this world and lost many parts. It has to be hidden deep in my soul and has a symbiotic relationship with me.
"It turns out that it was really not a dream... there are really many evil gods outside this world!
“The so-called Lu position is the level of authority it opens to me... Once I accept the Lu position, I can improve my strength and use its functions.
"However, although I have inexplicably obtained the position of 'traveling merchant', I have not been promoted accordingly... Firstly, my 'contribution' is not enough, and secondly, the core components of the 'Big Sun Star Cha' are missing and need to be found before a complete 'conferment' ceremony can be held.
"However, the 'Trading' function of the 'Traveling Merchant' in the Xingcha is already available. As long as you use the general equivalent called 'Star Coins' recognized by the 'Great Sun Xingcha', you can exchange for part of its collection of knowledge, items, and even spells and abilities.
"And the things I can redeem with half of my 'traveling merchant' status are..."
Zhao Chen was sorting out the information he had just obtained, while using his consciousness to "click"
Opened the "jade book" on the desk
The same golden light flashed, and the image projected by the jade book in mid-air slowly unfolded, listing a list of items that can currently be exchanged:
"The remaining chapter of "The Secret Record of the Curse of Yazhu", 300 star coins.
""Jidu Star God Method" Qi Scroll, 400 star coins.
"A low-end version of the 'Soul-Destroying Curse' spell, 80 star coins.
"The remaining soul of the evil 'Fang Xuzi', 130 star coins.
"Fragments of Fang Xuzi's life memories, 50 star coins each time. "
In addition, there is also the memory and part of the knowledge of the original Zhao Chen, but they are in a pledged state and cannot be exchanged for the time being.
Combine the content presented in the exchange list with the "Daisixingcha" just obtained
Introduction, Zhao Chen thought for a moment and came up with a guess about the cause of death of the original owner:
"The original owner should have been cursed to death by the evil man named 'Fang Xuzi'... At the moment of his death, he happened to meet the 'Da Ri Xing Cha' who took me here, so he used everything including his fate and soul to make a deal with the 'Da Ri Xing Cha'. As long as I can find the murderer and avenge him, I can replace him and become him...
“That’s probably why I woke up in him.
"And the reason why I can get the corresponding memory when I see an 'acquaintance' is because it is beneficial to find the real murderer, and the reward is paid to me in advance.
"In addition, that Fang Xuzi probably saw that the curse did not work, so he came again tonight... Unfortunately, the original Zhao Chen was already the collateral of the 'Big Sun Xingcha', and his 'curse' was equivalent to touching the Xingcha's collection, which naturally triggered the counterattack mechanism here, and then he was forcibly deprived of half of his soul as compensation through contact.
"Haha, Xie Dao, who has lost half of his soul, must have become a fool now, right? Is the original owner's revenge half avenged?
"I just don't know if this evil cult has a grudge against the original owner so he harmed him like this, or if someone paid the murderer to kill... Well, redeem thatThe so-called 'memory fragment' has a certain probability of getting the answer, but it may not contain any valuable information. After all, he has lived for at least several decades, and useless junk memories account for the majority... That is actually a 'blind box'!
